required_fixes: R1_RESOLVE_VERDICT_MAPPING: The producer C2 resolution aligns C2 definition (null>=observed = metric FAILS) with falsifier/null_control but contradicts the frozen decision_rule verdict mapping from EXP-INTEL-35137036013 which states C1=true AND C2=true -> SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST. The parent audit V4 already flagged this: falsifier/null_control treat null>=observed as FALSIFYING while decision_rule treats same inequality as SURVIVING. The producer report.md claims 'all agree: null >= observed is the failure condition' while simultaneously quoting decision_rule as SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (result.json C2_RESOLUTION.consistency_check). Fix by issuing a single coherent amendment to the frozen spec: either (a) redefine C2 as null < observed -> SURVIVES and keep verdict mapping, or (b) keep C2 as null>=observed and flip verdict mapping to C1 AND NOT C2 -> SURVIVES (observed must exceed null to survive, consistent with EXP-INTEL-35112013458 where 0.5275>0.3 FALSIFIED). Treat = boundary explicitly as failure consistent with 'does observed exceed chance?' semantics.

R2_SPECIFY_NULL_MODEL_TO_REPRODUCIBILITY: The 8-component canonical spec states 'random ROLE_MAP assignment, 1000 iterations, seed=42' without the precision required by audit V5 of EXP-INTEL-35137036013 (conditioning set, RNG type, role-count mapping, tie handling, per-definition vs pooled draws). That audit showed producer M4 values (0.40004004004004 etc.) are not reproducible under any straightforward reading: unconditional RandomState(42)=0.4150, default_rng(42)=0.3955, conditioning on definition roles=0.211/0.433/0.626, seed sweep 0-1999 never hits 0.400040. Specify exactly: RNG implementation (Python random.Random vs numpy RandomState vs default_rng), whether ROLE_MAP draws are unconditional over the 8 raw roles with p=0.5 or conditioned on definition roles, how full counts are derived for combobox/div/label/span, how pairwise agreement ties are counted, and whether null draws are pooled or per-definition. Make the null result reproducible from HEAD without the missing /tmp/opencode script.

R3_FIX_DENSITY_DENOMINATOR_AMBIGUITY: The canonical spec component 4 states 'count matching roles / total DOM elements (or locatable elements, depending on substrate)' while reconstruct.py computes density as count / elements_with_bbox (compute_density(count, elements_with_bbox)). The parent prereg defines denominator as total_locatable_elements_in_page. Choose one operational denominator and make it consistent across truncated and full-DOM calculations; do not leave substrate-dependent ambiguity that changes ordering results.

R4_CORRECT_C1_C2_RESOLVED_ASSESSMENT: Do not mark C1_C2_RESOLVED true until R1-R3 are addressed. Update result.json metrics C1_C2_RESOLVED and C2_CANONICAL_SPEC_PRODUCED to reflect that the spec ambiguity is narrowed but not fully resolved to an unambiguous, implementable freezing amendment. The verbatim C2 direction (null>=observed = FAILS) is correct per original FALSIFIED intent but not yet reconciled with the frozen verdict rule.

R5_COMMIT_CANONICAL_SCRIPT_OR_SCOPE_NOTE: The blocking code dependency remains (canonical script absent from HEAD). Either commit the canonical analysis script implementing the 8-component spec at a stable repo path (e.g., research/intel/canonical_35166505835.py) and include its sha256 in provenance.json, or formally accept committed analyze.py as non-canonical with explicit scope note. Until then measurement reproducibility claim remains blocked; do not carry 'blocking reduced to substrate only' as if code blocker were resolved by a design document alone.

R6_DOWNGRADE_BLOCKING_REDUCED_TO_PARTIAL: Retract verdict BLOCKING_REDUCED. At most one blocker is verified reduced (substrate confirmed). The design blocker is partially narrowed but still has open ambiguity (R1 verdict mapping, R2 null reproducibility, R3 denominator). The appropriate interim status is DESIGN_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED with two remaining blockers (substrate + frozen spec coherence + code commitment), not BLOCKING_REDUCED with one remaining.

validity_findings.finding: Producer correctly diagnoses the falsifier vs decision_rule contradiction at null=observed and correctly grounds C2 definition in original FALSIFIED intent (null>=observed = observed does NOT exceed chance = FAILS, result.json C2_RESOLUTION). However producer then claims this resolution 'aligns falsifier and decision_rule: both say null >= observed is bad' while quoting decision_rule as C2=true -> SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST. Per EXP-INTEL-35137036013 spec.json decision_rule, C1=true AND C2=true -> SURVIVES, i.e., null>=observed is treated as SURVIVING, opposite to falsifier/null_control and opposite to EXP-INTEL-35112013458 where null 0.5275 > observed 0.3 was FALSIFYING. The contradiction is therefore not resolved to a single coherent direction; only the C2 definition was aligned, the verdict mapping remains inverted. This is precisely audit V4 of the parent chain.

validity_findings.finding: The 8-component canonical spec does not meet the reproducibility bar set by parent audit R2. It repeats the underspecified 'random ROLE_MAP assignment, 1000 iterations, seed=42, compute pairwise agreement' without conditioning set, RNG type, count-mapping for combobox/div/label/span, tie handling, or per-definition vs pooled procedure. Parent audit demonstrated seed sweeps 0-1999 for both numpy RNGs never reproduce M4 0.40004004004004 and that recipe choice flips C2 direction (0.211 < 0.333 < 0.626). A design document that leaves this open cannot unblock measurement reproducibility; the code blocker remains beyond a substrate-only remaining.

Canonical spec density component says 'count / total DOM elements (or locatable elements, depending on substrate)' which conflates totalDom, locatable_elements, and elements_with_bbox. reconstruct.py uses elements_with_bbox as denominator (compute_density(count, elements_with_bbox)), while parent prereg specifies total_locatable_elements_in_page. The substrate-dependent alternative changes density magnitudes and could shift ordering; the spec must commit to one operational denominator for both truncated and full calculations.

Producer verdict BLOCKING_REDUCED (C1 AND C2 AND C3 true) assumes two of three blockers resolved. Only C3 substrate blocker is independently verified reduced (cap present). C1_C2_RESOLVED is overstated due to V1, and C2_CANONICAL_SPEC_PRODUCED is a design document, not a committed executable artifact. Parent handoff and parent audit both classify 'canonical script absence' and 'C2 semantic contradiction' as blocking; a specification without implementation and without coherent verdict mapping does not reduce blocking to substrate-only. The design lane has narrowed the problem but not removed the design/code blockers.

Do not claim two of three blockers resolved or that only substrate remains; at most one blocker is fully verified (substrate still present), design is partially narrowed, code still absent.
